groups.name: A. A long number as digits, and adding

problems.title: lottery
problems.tech: the number as a string of digits; ten boxes, one per digit - which digit turns up again?

problems.title: fib
problems.tech: add the last two numbers digit by digit

problems.title: sheeps
problems.tech: `a(k) = a(k-1) + a(k-3)` grows past `long long` - add long numbers

problems.title: difference
problems.tech: the digits as a string: sort them both ways, then subtract digit by digit

problems.title: sdnf
problems.tech: multiply by 2, 3, ..., n, then add up the digits

problems.title: degrees
problems.tech: double the number by adding it to itself, again and again

problems.title: sub
problems.tech: sort the digits both ways and subtract the two long numbers
